author: AaronH
rules:
i've been looking at a little sumthing else, lucky i put a little in the bank.

congratulations to evan on the first month of sudokubank.

rules

• 6x6 sudoku: fill the grid with digits 1-6 so that no digit repeats in any row, column or box.

there is a negative constraint in this puzzle.

• x sums: an x connects two digits that sum to 10. all s are given.

• split pea lines: the digits along a split pea line, not counting the circles, sum to the number formed by writing the two circle digits side by side in either order.

• black dots: a black dot connects two digits where one is exactly double the other. not all dots are necessarily given.
